```{python}
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

train_set.head()
test_set.head()

```{python}
sns.histplot(data, x='price')
plt.show()
```

```{python}
price_cuts = np.quantile(data['price'], [0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8])
```

```{python}
data['price_cat'] = pd.cut(data['price'], bins=[-np.inf,price_cuts[0], price_cuts[1], price_cuts[2], price_cuts[3], np.inf], labels=[1, 2, 3, 4, 5])
```

```{python}
data["price_cat"].value_counts(normalize = True).sort_index().plot.bar(rot = 0, color = "dodgerblue")
plt.xlabel("Categoría de precio")
plt.ylabel("Proporción")
plt.title("Bar chart del precio discretizado")
plt.show()
```

```{python}
strat_train, strat_test = create_train_test(data, test_size = 0.3, stratify = data['price_cat'], random_state = 1234)

strat_test['price_cat'].value_counts(normalize=True).sort_values()
```


```{python}
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize = (9, 4))

## Histograma en el training set
sns.histplot(strat_train, x = "price", ax = ax1, bins = 18,
             color = "dodgerblue", stat = "density")
sns.kdeplot(strat_train["price"], ax = ax1,
            color = "black", linewidth = 2)
ax1.set_title("Histograma del precio de vivienda")
ax1.set_xlabel("Precio ($)")
ax1.set_ylabel("Densidad")

## Histograma en el test set
sns.histplot(strat_test, x = "price", ax = ax2, bins = 18,
             color = "dodgerblue", stat = "density")
sns.kdeplot(strat_test["price"], ax = ax2,
            color = "black", linewidth = 2)
ax2.set_title("Histograma del precio de vivienda")
ax2.set_xlabel("Precio ($)")
ax2.set_ylabel("Densidad")
plt.show();
```

```{python}
for set_ in (strat_train, strat_test):
    set_.drop(columns = 'price_cat', inplace = True)
